findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a maintainer closes this release with Forge v1.2.36 installed from its published tag.
From the release worktree, `forge close` checks the new pin and tries to fetch v1.2.37 from GitHub (`src/forge/cli.py:147`, `src/forge/repo.py:1013`, `src/forge/repo.py:1034`). The documented release process pushes that tag only after the fix is closed and merged (`docs/guide.md:674`, `docs/guide.md:680`). Running close from the default checkout does not avoid the problem: `src/forge/close.py:829` rejects the fix's pin when close itself is running v1.2.36. The published installation therefore cannot complete the documented release path.
findings.title: Functional: The new pin blocks closing the release before tagging
